summary: Iteration 12 retest of all Phase 2a fixes from iteration_11. Backend: 33/33 tests pass (added 2 new retest cases — graceful Whisper fallback and only-owner demote guard — plus a voice-note summarize regression). All 3 backend fixes verified: (1) POST /api/voice-notes → GET /api/files/{id} now returns 200 audio bytes (file schema aligned to storage_path/original_filename/is_deleted), (2) transcribe of silent/tiny audio returns 200 with text='' instead of 500, (3) PATCH /api/admin/users/{id} blocks demoting the only owner with 400 'Cannot demote the only owner'. Regression suites (iteration9 invites, iteration10 referrals, auto_finalize_research) all 54 tests still pass. ui_bugs.issue: PARTIAL FIX. The `u.status || 'active'` fallback only handles null/undefined; but invited-but-not-redeemed users have status='invited' (set by backend at server.py:288) and bulk-invited users have status='pending' (server.py:1625,1699). Neither value is in STATUSES = ['active','disabled'] (AdminDashboard.jsx:31), so Radix Select renders blank for those rows. Verified: 10 of 29 admin-status-* selects render empty (all 'Invited User' rows). Fix options: (a) add 'invited' and 'pending' to STATUSES, or (b) coerce: value={(['active','disabled'].includes(u.status) ? u.status : 'active')}, or (c) backend public_admin_user could map invited→active for the select but keep a separate 'joined' badge.

action_items: FRONTEND MINOR: AdminDashboard Status select still shows blank for invited/pending users. Either extend STATUSES to include 'invited'/'pending' or coerce unknown statuses to 'active' in the Select value prop. Current `u.status || 'active'` only catches null, not the truthy 'invited'/'pending' strings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2425 lines — split into routers (auth, files, voice_notes, approvals, admin, referrals) is overdue.

Voice-note transcribe error-classifier (lines 1941-1945) uses substring matching on str(e).lower() — fragile. Prefer catching openai.BadRequestError / openai.UnprocessableEntityError explicitly, falling back to a generic decode-failure path.

summarize_voice_note (line 1954) still raises 500 on transcription failure instead of using the same graceful empty-text fallback as transcribe_voice_note. Inconsistent behavior between the two endpoints.
AdminDashboard STATUSES constant is too narrow given backend emits 4 statuses (active, disabled, invited, pending). The Select silently breaks for invited rows.

rca of the issue: AdminDashboard Status select blank rendering: backend stores status='invited' for non-redeemed invites and status='pending' for bulk-invites. Frontend STATUSES whitelist is only ['active','disabled']. The new fix `u.status || 'active'` is bypassed because 'invited' is truthy, so Radix Select gets a value not in its SelectItem list and falls back to rendering nothing. Reproduction: login as amit → /admin → Users tab → any 'Invited User' row → Status column is blank. Mitigation: extend STATUSES or coerce: `value={['active','disabled'].includes(u.status) ? u.status : 'active'}`.
